scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @stream-overlay/overlay && npm run build --workspace @stream-overlay/control
scripts.bundle: npm run bundle:server && npm run bundle:main
scripts.desktop: npm run build && npm run bundle && npm run start --workspace @stream-overlay/desktop
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run bundle && npm run dist --workspace @stream-overlay/desktop
scripts.release:win: npm run build && npm run bundle && npm run dist --workspace @stream-overlay/desktop -- --publish always
